label: Lead Funnel (the inbound engine as an object)
description: THE INBOUND ENGINE AS AN OBJECT -- not a chart of numbers (that is funnel-chart). A funnel draws itself in ink; its bands (default Attract / Nurture / Qualify, set your own 2-4) light up one by one on their cues, each label in the brand serif. People are DOTS: they pour in from channel chips above the mouth (sources: words or logos) and settle in the top band, cold grey; when the middle band lights, nurture touches ping (email, webinar, content icons) and the warmed dots -- in the brand colour -- drop a band; when the last band lights the qualified dots run hot (magenta) and drop again. Then ONE qualified lead leaves through the neck and becomes a named person (initials avatar + name) -- the HAND-OFF to the next piece (a lead score, a sales note): its anchor 'handoff' is what a morph or a cut picks up. Use it for the marketing-funnel argument: 'attract, nurture, qualify', 'marketing needs a pipeline too', 'from first touch to a raised hand'. Time it to the words: give each band's at the second its word is spoken (anchor bands[i].at to the word), handoff.at the moment the lead is named. Draws in one SVG (600x800 viewBox, contained), so a tall phone box or a wide split both read; dots never sit on a label or an icon. THE LOOP (data.loop, optional): after the hand-off an arc runs back up to the chips and 'Smarter with every click' lands above them -- the funnel learns from every click; give it about a second after the hand-off. CONTINUE (data.continue: true): the funnel picks up where the scene before left it, so a relay can carry one funnel across cuts (one stage per scene, the camera locked) -- anything cued at 0 or before has already happened (the outline drawn, those bands lit, their dots where they landed) and only the later cues play; give every scene after the first continue:true and the earlier bands at 0. FOUR BANDS (e.g. Attract / Collect / Nurture / Qualify): the dots step down through every band, hot in the last; touch_band says which band the nurture touches ping in. CAMERA ANCHORS: funnel, band-N, source-N, handoff, loop.

bands.label: The funnel's bands top to bottom: [{label, at}] (default Attract 0.9s, Nurture 2.2s, Qualify 3.4s) -- 2-4 bands; the band lights, its label lands and its dots move at `at`

sources.label: Channel chips above the mouth the dots pour from: [{label} | {src: logo image url}, at?] (default Blog, LinkedIn, Search, Webinars); false hides them

touches.label: Nurture touch icons that ping in the nurture band (the second, or touch_band): email | webinar | content (default all three); false hides them

touch_band.label: Which band the nurture touches ping in, counting the top band as 0 (default 1, the second band; 2 for Attract / Collect / Nurture / Qualify)

handoff.label: The lead who leaves through the neck: {name (default 'Sarah Chen'), initials?, at? (default 1.3s after the last band)}; false = nobody leaves

loop.label: The LOOP (the funnel learns): true or {label? (default 'Smarter with every click'), at? (default 0.9s after the hand-off)} -- an arc runs from the bottom round the right side back to the channel chips, the chips pulse once and the line lands above them. Off unless set

nurture_share.label: Share of dots that get nurtured into the second band (default 0.55)

qualify_share.label: Share that qualify into the last band (default 0.22)

collect_share.label: Four bands only: share of dots that drop into the second band (default 0.75); nurture_share and qualify_share then set the third and fourth

stream.label: Seconds the dots take to pour in (default 1.3)

warm_color.label: Nurtured dots + lit bands (default the brand primary)

ink_color.label: Funnel line, labels, chips (default the brand text colour)

font.label: Band label font (default 'Newsreader', the brand serif)

at.label: Shift the whole performance by this many seconds

continue.label: Pick up where the scene before left the funnel: no redraw, and every band, source and touch cued at 0 or before is already done (lit, dots in place). For a funnel carried across cuts
